_about: The water between the banks: quiet spreads and small reaction spots between the cards, running Friday to Monday. Each carries a slot for Snacks' reimagined Laverne & Shirley theme (his own original lyrics) and, where it fits, one line from his welcome letter. 'after' = id of the card it follows, or 'end' for the closing coda. kind: spread | pair | single. layout: a | b | c | finale. tone: river | night | butter | ember | paper. lyric: one entry per line of his song, in order; 'len' is a rough placeholder width (letters) until 'text' is filled in. note = his letter line, verbatim. Fill a lyric by adding "text" to its line; the placeholder disappears.

credit.text: After the Laverne & Shirley theme, “Making Our Dreams Come True”
